key.name: arrangements
key.summary: Per-group arrangement, parallel to workspace index: "free" or "tabbed"

key.name: search-windows
key.description: Chrome uses Ctrl+Shift+A, but that belongs to applications; a global grab would take it away from them.

key.name: debug-interface
key.summary: Export a D-Bus interface for tests to read state and drive the extension
key.description: Off in normal use. Tests need an oracle that reports what the extension believes, rather than inferring it from pixels.

key.name: blur
key.summary: Frost the content behind the sidebar, so it reads as floating above the windows

key.name: reveal-style
key.summary: How the sidebar appears: swing opens it like a door in perspective, slide moves it in flat

key.name: sidebar-margin
key.summary: Gap between the sidebar and the screen edges, in logical pixels

key.name: compact
key.summary: Shrink the sidebar to icons only, like Chrome's collapsed vertical tabs

key.name: expand-on-hover
key.summary: While compact, expand the sidebar over the windows when the pointer is on it

key.name: compact-width
key.summary: Sidebar width in compact mode, in logical pixels

key.name: auto-hide
key.summary: Slide the sidebar off screen and reveal it by pushing the pointer into the left edge

key.name: auto-group
key.summary: When a window is tagged, move it into the group named after that tag, creating the group if needed

key.name: layout-states
key.summary: Per-group layout state as JSON ({ratios, masterRatio}), parallel to workspace index

key.name: gap
key.summary: Gap between tiled windows, in logical pixels

key.name: outer-gap
key.summary: Gap between tiled windows and the edge of the work area

key.name: colors
key.summary: Per-group colour name, parallel to workspace index
